question: Which of the following musicians have won the Dada Saheb Phalke Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulzar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Gulzar** (Sampooran Singh Kalra), a renowned lyricist, poet, and filmmaker, won the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** in **2013**.
 
• This is India’s highest award in cinema, given for outstanding contributions to the growth and development of Indian cinema.
 
• Gulzar has made significant contributions through his exceptional lyrics, screenwriting, and direction in the Indian film industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Md. Rafi**:

 
 
• Mohammed Rafi, one of the greatest playback singers in Indian cinema, is celebrated for his versatile singing. However, he did not receive the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** during his lifetime.
 
 
 
• 
 
**A.R. Rahman**:

 
 
• A.R. Rahman, an internationally acclaimed composer and musician, has won numerous awards, including two Academy Awards and a Padma Bhushan. However, he has not been a recipient of the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** as of now.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Kishore Kumar**:

 
 
• Kishore Kumar, a legendary playback singer, actor, and filmmaker, has made an indelible mark on Indian cinema. Despite his immense contributions, he did not receive the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** during his career or posthumously.
